title: MCP Capability Manifest
description: Canonical, platform-agnostic schema for describing a connected MCP server's capabilities, scope tiers, and live rate-limit usage. Used by the Sales Stack Router skill, but intentionally generic enough for any multi-MCP-server orchestration, not just sales-engagement tools.

server_id.description: Unique identifier for this connected server instance, e.g. 'outreach-prod-1'.

status.description: Live connection health. Only 'connected' servers should ever be routed to.

priority.description: Lower = preferred when multiple servers can fulfill the same request. Optional.

rate_limit.description: Optional. NEVER hardcode a vendor's advertised limit here without checking the account's real plan — advertised limits vary by tier and change over time.

usage_this_window.description: Caller-supplied live count of calls already made in the current rate-limit window. Must be fresh — this schema does not track state.
